List every invoice you have sent and note its due date
Define the first reminder to go out one day after the due date
Schedule a second reminder for seven days overdue
Plan a third reminder at fourteen days overdue with a firmer tone
Add a final notice at thirty days overdue that mentions next steps
Choose the communication channel for each reminder (email, message, call)
Write a short template for each reminder stage
Set calendar alerts or task reminders for each send date
Log the actual send date and any client response in your tracker

Choose the reminder stage that matches the invoice age (polite, firm, final).
Open the corresponding template file for your preferred channel (email or chat).
Replace placeholder fields with the client name, invoice number, amount, and due date.
Add a clear call to action such as a payment link or reply instruction.
Proofread the message for tone and accuracy before sending.
Send the reminder from your business email or chat account.
Log the send date, channel, and template version in your tracking sheet.
Set a follow-up reminder for the next stage if payment is not received.
Archive sent messages in a dedicated folder for future reference.
Review response rates monthly and adjust wording if needed.
phase3_step2_module-3.md: This module gives you a single spreadsheet to record every invoice, its due date, reminder actions, and payment confirmation. Use it each week to see what needs follow‑up and what has been settled.
Create a new sheet using the column headings provided
Enter each outstanding invoice with client name, invoice number, amount, and due date
Mark the reminder status as Not Sent, First Sent, Second Sent, or Final Sent
Set a calendar alert for the due date and each reminder milestone
Send the first reminder email on the due date using your standard template
Update the reminder status to First Sent after the email goes out
Send a second reminder three business days later if payment has not arrived
Update the reminder status to Second Sent after the second email
Send a final notice seven business days after the due date if still unpaid
Record the payment date and method once the money is received
Change the reminder status to Paid and archive the row
Review the dashboard every Monday to catch any overdue items
